title: run_sse CRLF normalization is per-chunk so split CRLF across chunks is not normalized
description:
client.rs run_sse normalizes CRLF to LF with replace("
", "
") per chunk before appending to buf (line 252). If a TCP chunk ends with  and the next chunk begins with 
 (the 
 sequence is split across two chunks), the  remains in buf and the 
 is at the start of the next chunk. After appending both, buf contains 
 but the replace was already done per-chunk so the 
 is never normalized. The resulting buf would have a bare  followed by 
, which could cause parse_sse_event lines() to produce garbled line content (trailing  on the previous line, empty line from the 
). SSE spec sends CRLF-terminated lines; HTTP/1.1 chunked encoding can split at arbitrary byte boundaries. This is a correctness issue in the buffer handling.
